input_relative_residual.formula: abs(recomputed - target) / max(abs(target), 1e-12), maximum over production and consumption and all groups
input_relative_residual.OK: maximum <= 0.0001 (0.01%), unless another input warning applies

divergence.detritus_gain: b = spectral radius of diag(theta) @ B; FAIL at b >= 1; WARN when 0.7 < b < 1
divergence.living_gain: rho_living = spectral radius of A_LL; FAIL at rho >= 1; WARN when 0.7 < rho < 1
divergence.detrital_coefficient: WARN when maximum reported detrital diagonal >= 10
divergence.negative_SPPR: Any basal source column containing a strict negative SPPR causes FAIL
divergence.near_zero_TE: A nonbasal group with 0 < abs(TE) < 0.001 gives WARN; alone it does not cause overall FAIL

strict_booleans.production: all numpy.isclose(recomputed production, P): rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8
strict_booleans.consumption: all numpy.isclose(recomputed consumption, Q): rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6
strict_booleans.PP_budget: numpy.isclose(inflow, outflow): rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8; reference magnitude is outflow

production_residual_audit.sign_convention: r_i = recomputed production outflows - P_i; positive means modeled production outflows exceed stored P. The existing living reconciliation CSV uses the opposite sign P minus outflows.
production_residual_audit.native_formula: recomputed production = total catch (landings + discards) + predation + biomass accumulation + (emigration - immigration - detritus import) + effective M0 + EE-floor external mortality sink
production_residual_audit.discard_accounting: Discards occur once in donor total-catch removal. The same mass re-enters the detritus pool once through discard_returns, and is subtracted from external catch in PP budget accounting; it is not added a second time to donor production outflows.
production_residual_audit.consumption_interpretation: The engine builds consumption from recomputed production plus egestion plus respiration. Consequently an existing production mismatch can appear in the Q residual; this is not by itself evidence that published QB was mistranscribed.
production_residual_audit.correction_scope_caution: Even if a Fin whale source extraction error is established and corrected, five other currently retained groups already exceed the 10% production threshold. A corrected-run status cannot be asserted from this retained run.
